component.name: Launchme
component.summary: Your games from every store in one console-style library

description.p: Launchme is a full-screen, console-style game launcher built for a gamepad. It brings the games you have installed through Steam, Heroic (Epic Games and GOG), Lutris and Prism Launcher into one library, with artwork, details and trailers, and starts them for you.

ul.li: Home layouts in the style of game consoles, a desktop window with a sidebar and details pane
Grid, list, cinematic, coverflow and shelf library views with sorting, filters and search
Covers, backgrounds and logos from SteamGridDB and the stores themselves
Playtime, achievements and ratings for each game
Glance: news about your games and new releases, read in a reader window driven by the pad
An optional AI companion that knows your library

description.p: The interface is available in English, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish.
Hide to tray while playing, background crops, the stores' own artwork for every store, Steam trailers for games from other stores, and social dynamics for the companion.
Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish, Epic artwork, faster missing artwork, and a local semantic memory for the companion.
